description: What a healthy restore of the demo shop database must contain. 'tables' maps each table to its minimum row count; every 'queries' entry must return true. scripts/seed_source_db.py creates data that satisfies this.

queries.name: every order item belongs to an order
queries.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.id IS NULL)

queries.name: every order belongs to a customer
queries.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.id IS NULL)

queries.name: no negative prices
queries.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM products WHERE price < 0)
